messages:
Maya R: Heads-up — saw a surge of partial responses and socket closures hitting /v1/stream-gateway at ~03:05 UTC. Several clients retried and surfaced user-facing hangs. Can we capture owners and immediate mitigations?
Liam T: I pulled logs, looks like many upstreams hit a 30s idle timeout on the gateway connection and then clients retried aggressively. Snippet: `socket: EOF; write: broken pipe; upstream idle 30s` :thinking_face:
OpsBot: alert: stream-gateway error-rate spike (partial_response) 03:04–03:10 UTC — 72 events — severity: medium
SRE Bot: Created incident INC-341234 — tagging oncall. Initial hypothesis: handshake stall -> idle timeout -> client retries -> partial outputs.
Eva C: Hypothesis +1. We also see a correlated bump in attach/handshake latency on the LB. Two quick mitigations: 1) increase gateway idle timeout from 30s -> 90s for r/w sessions (temp), 2) add jittered exponential client backoff to prevent sync retries.
Priya S: Agree. Proposed action items: 
- A1: Short-term gateway timeout bump (owner: @Liam T) — due: 3412350800 (~+15m).
- A2: Client retry policy enforcement in SDK (owner: @Eva C) — due: 3412440000 (~+1 day).
- A3: Add prefix/KV cache telemetry for partial-response detection (owner: @Priya S) — due: 3412600000 (~+3 days).
- A4: Run a smoke test against long-poll sessions and measure partial-response rate (owner: @Liam T + @SRE Bot) — due: 3412352000 (~+30m).
Liam T: Taking A1 and A4. Will open a short-lived feature flag and roll to 10% -> 50% -> 100% if green. Will paste rollout plan.
Eva C: I'll prep SDK change and a small test harness. For retries: suggest algo `backoff = min(2^n * base, 30s) + random(0, jitter)` and a client-side circuit-breaker after 5 attempts.
Maya R: Please include monitoring alerts for partial-response ratio > 0.5% and handshake p99 > 500ms. Also link to postmortem triage doc once we consolidate.
Priya S: Noted. I'll own the follow-up tracker and weekly cadence. Plan: daily 10:00 UTC check-ins for 72 hours, then weekly until regression-free for 30 days.
SRE Bot: Action items recorded: A1 (Liam T), A2 (Eva C), A3 (Priya S), A4 (Liam T).
Liam T: Rollout plan: `ff-allow-gateway-timeout-bump=true` -> rollout-script: `./deploy.sh --flag ff-allow-gateway-timeout-bump --percent=10` — will monitor metrics: partial_resp_rate, handshake_latency, closed_sockets.
Eva C: Posting quick repro steps and a minimal client test in #eng-runtime later.
Maya R: Query for recurring pattern: can ops run a 30-day histogram on partial responses by hour + region? If pattern repeats, we'll need a deeper fix in the gateway handshake code path.
Priya S: @SRE Bot — can you schedule the 72-hour daily reminders and attach action item checklist to the incident? :spiral_calendar:
SRE Bot: Scheduled reminders at 10:00 UTC for next 3 days. Checklist attached to INC-341234.
Maya R: Thanks all. We'll sync again after A1/A4 are complete. If anyone hits a blocker ping me and I'll escalate. :thumbsup:
